app: Mac native (ParparVM) agent-debug build driven over the live MCP

picture.compress.rule:
The native codec really resamples (the JVM test uses a fake codec): the crop must be applied
and the picture re-encoded. Size is not compared: the 68-byte fixture is below any encoder's overhead.

references.researcher.rule: Researcher queries live Wikipedia natively (the JVM test uses a fixed answer): a website source must be added.

table.autofit.rule: Column widths come from native font metrics (the JVM uses PDF metrics); structure must match.

table.eraser.rule: The native editor keeps the caret in the merged cell (as Word does); the JVM session leaves the table. Document must match.
